banner.title: The Exiled Heavy Knight Knows How To Game The System
banner.description: follows Elymas Edvaughn, a young noble born into a prestigious family of master swordsmen who awakens the defense-specialized "Heavy Knight" class—widely branded as defective and useless due to low offensive power—during his coming-of-age ceremony, leading to his subsequent disinheritance and exile.
